explain.say: You need 7 more. A 5 cent coin and a 2 cent coin make 7. Count on along the line: start at 20, add 7, and land on 27. So 20, 5 and 2 make 27 cents. Can you find a different way?
Wonderful! Two 20s and a 10 also make 50, but one 50 cent coin is the fewest. Wow: India has coins of 1, 2, 5, 10 and 20 rupees, and the same trick works there. Challenge: make 35 with three coins.

faq.q: Why is a small coin sometimes worth more?
faq.a: A coin is worth the number written on it, not its size. In euros, the 10 cent coin is smaller than the 5 cent coin, but it is worth twice as much.
asks: Is a bigger coin worth more?

faq.q: How do I make 27 cents with coins?
faq.a: Start with the biggest coin that fits: 20 cents. Then you need 7 more, which is a 5 cent and a 2 cent coin. 20 plus 5 plus 2 is 27.

faq.q: What is the fewest coins to make 50?
faq.a: One 50 cent coin is the fewest. You could also use two 20s and a 10, but that is three coins.
asks: How can I make 50 with the fewest coins?

faq.q: How many cents are in a euro?
faq.a: There are 100 cents in one euro. Many money systems split the main unit into 100 parts, like 100 paise in a rupee and 100 kobo in a naira.
asks: How many cents make one whole?

faq.q: How do I count a pile of coins?
faq.a: Sort the coins by value, then start with the biggest and count on. Two 20s, a 5 and a 2: 20, 40, 45, 47.
asks: What is the best way to count coins?

facts: Euro coins come in 1, 2, 5, 10, 20 and 50 cents, plus 1 and 2 euros.
The euro 10 cent coin is smaller than the 5 cent coin but worth twice as much.
One rupee is 100 paise, and one naira is 100 kobo.

quiz.say: What is the fewest coins that make 70 cents?
quiz.show: What is the fewest coins that make 70 cents?

wrong.1: 50, 10 and 10 do make 70, but that is 3 coins.
wrong.2: Seven 10s make 70, but that is far more coins.
